questions.q: The head of sales asks, "Where does our revenue come from, and are discounts working?" What is the best first step?
options: Start plotting every column
Train a machine learning model immediately
Sharpen the request into specific questions and define the revenue metric before touching the data
Delete rows with missing values
questions.explain: A vague request has to become specific, answerable questions and a precise metric definition before any analysis starts.

questions.q: In this capstone, how is revenue defined?
options: quantity x unit price x (1 - discount), counted only for completed orders
The sum of unit_price for all orders, including returns and cancellations
The number of orders per month
quantity + unit price
questions.explain: Revenue is quantity times unit price after discount, and returned or cancelled orders don't count as revenue.

questions.q: Why do we generate the capstone data from a seeded NumPy generator?
options: Because pandas cannot read real files
So every student gets identical data and identical numbers, while still containing realistic problems
Because seeds make data cleaner
Because real datasets are never messy
questions.explain: A fixed seed makes the illustrative dataset reproducible, so results can be compared and checked.

questions.q: Why do we audit the raw file before writing any cleaning code?
options: Auditing automatically fixes the file
Cleaning code cannot run without an audit
The audit changes the file to remove duplicates
To find the actual problems (duplicates, missing values, wrong types, outliers) and write each fix as an explicit decision
questions.explain: Inspect first, change nothing, and record every issue. Each issue then becomes a deliberate, documented cleaning step.

questions.q: Which folder rule keeps a project reproducible?
options: Edit the raw file directly so there is only one copy
Keep raw data untouched in data/raw and write cleaned output to a separate folder
Store raw and cleaned data in the same file
Delete the raw data after cleaning
questions.explain: Untouched raw data lets you rerun the whole pipeline from scratch and verify every cleaning step.
